The '''Storm Fleet destroyer''' was a [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]] model made by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
The destroyer was clad with dull, black durasteel plating.
Each ship was armed with [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|quad laser cannons]] and [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] launchers.<ref name="SFW" />

==History==
The [[Storm Fleet]] consisted of these vessels and used their combined firepower to subjugate neutral worlds and take their resources and/or facilities. They were disguised as massive freighters in order to travel relatively safely to their targets. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] managed to destroy the fleet with the help of their [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilots]] a few months after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]].<ref name="SFW" />
